title: Equal circles in a regular polygon with the largest radius

template.title: {n} equal circles in the regular polygon of Packomania section {section}
template.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles of equal radius in the regular polygon of section {section} (circumradius 1) so that the radius is as large as possible.
template.submission: Text file: the radius on the first line, then {n} lines with the centres (decimal numbers), in the frame of checkers/pack_alg_check.py: the polygon centred at 0 with a vertex at (1, 0).
